questions.question: To help bring David's son Absalom home, Joab sent to the town of Tekoa for what kind of woman?
After telling King David a story about her two sons, a woman from Tekoa said his ruling showed he was guilty of what?

answers.text: Not bringing back his own banished son
Ignoring the widows of his kingdom
Breaking an old vow to the LORD

questions.question: When King David allowed his son Absalom to return from Geshur to Jerusalem, what condition did he give?

answers.text: He must not see the king's face
He must stay outside the city walls
He must never speak to Joab again

questions.question: When Absalom bowed facedown before his father King David after years apart, what did the king do?

answers.text: Ordered him out of the city
